title: Resident tissue macrophages transfer selenium transporter protein to protect pancreatic cancer from ferroptosis.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Paper is paywalled with no PMCID, so no full text or supplement. A GEO search found GSE335777, a series with the paper's title: mouse (Mus musculus) expression profiling by high-throughput sequencing, 43 samples, public since 2026-09-23. It has CSV/MTX/TAR/TSV supplementary files. One sample name is 'Mrc1_SEPP1_KO_48_M', a gene-knockout condition. I did not download the matrices.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: single-cell profiling, spatial analysis, lineage tracing, macrophage depletion and selenium tracing in mouse pancreatic cancer, plus human tissue showing SEPP1+ macrophages at the tumour border.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO series GSE335777 is public (seen in GEO metadata). The paper's own supplement could not be retrieved because the paper is paywalled.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: This is a study of how cancer works, built around experimental conditions (knockouts, depletion). Any label, such as cell type or EMT (epithelial-mesenchymal transition) state, would have to be built through clustering or annotation; no measured outcome column exists.

a3_inputs_present.note: Count matrices (MTX/TSV) are listed in the GEO metadata; not opened.

a4_units_stated.note: Counts from sequencing; not checked in the files.

a5_enough_rows.note: 43 GEO samples (from GEO metadata), a handful per condition. Single-cell barcodes inside the samples are not independent labelled examples.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not checkable without the full text.

a8_label_provenance.note: Cell-state labels such as EMT-high or resident-macrophage identity would come from clustering and marker scores computed on the same expression features, so the label leaks from the inputs.

backbone.name: scGPT / Geneformer (single-cell foundation models), in principle

honest_claim_h3: No supervised prediction task with an independently measured label: this is a mechanism study with about 43 mouse samples across perturbation conditions.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-cell gene expression from mouse pancreatic tumours to predict which tumour cells sit near protective resident macrophages.
plain_idea.train_on: Single-cell expression profiles from 43 mouse sequencing samples (from GEO metadata); the number of cells is unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Cell state (EMT-high or not) or macrophage origin. These labels come from the authors' clustering and lineage tracing, not from an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Cancer biologists studying macrophage-tumour niches might find it useful, but the labels would be circular and the sample count tiny, so we would learn little.

ml_idea: None viable. Under 50 perturbation samples, and the cell-state labels are derived from the expression features themselves.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count of GEO samples (43) and the lack of any measured outcome column; already done.

verdict_reason: A mechanism study of mouse pancreatic cancer. GEO GSE335777 has 43 perturbation samples and no measured label; cell-state labels would be built from the same expression data (fails A2, A5 and A8).
